system.description:
You reshape metal to repair and reinforce it.

Choose a space of metal within 10 spaces.

You can move that metal to an adjacent space, so long as it remains adjacent to a fixed object, like a wall.

Alternatively, you can carefully sculpt metal while the spell is active, such as creating a hammer out of a bar of iron.

You can also use this spell to repair magical and non-magical weapons, armor, and devices.

If you do so, the object is immediately restored to full working condition. Weapons are repaired, armor is restored to its maximum rating, and broken machines return to full functionality.

Additionally, affected items gain the Magical trait for 1 hour.

Each extra success extends the duration of the Magical trait by +1 hours.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.oYbXsX3gW6yAOX7n]{Shape Metal}
